name: patient-intake-frontend
description: Unified build orchestrator for the 4-app patient-intake frontend (Base Website + Patient/Doctor/Admin dashboards, static-exported to dist/).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix "Base Website" install && npm --prefix patient install && npm --prefix doctor install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npx next build && node ../scripts/move-out.cjs out ../dist/admin
scripts.build:base: cd "Base Website" && npx next build && node ../scripts/move-out.cjs out ../dist
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.cjs dist && npm run build:patient && npm run build:doctor && npm run build:admin && npm run build:base
